claim: An unassigned variable in a boolean parameter slot is constantly 0 (false), so the instruction never does the thing it looks like it does.
why: mlog has no bool type: `p1.bool()` is `num() != 0`, and an unset variable is 0. Harmless when it is a signature, fatal when it was meant to be a switch. Downgraded WARN -> INFO on 2026-10-29: a boolean slot reads null as false, so nothing fails there -- same policy as undefined-var-read, which is the generic rule this one specialises.
